description: A sample rate reducer and distortion whose carrier is amplitude modulated, with a stereo effect path and a separate synth voice on its own jack

params.text: Picks the band the carrier frequency knob works in
Takes the effect out of circuit, passing the input through untouched
Sets the carrier frequency, which is the rate the input is resampled at
Sets the level of the stereo effect output
Sets the drive into the distortion, multiplied by whatever the range switch beside it is set to
Switches the modulator in and out; with it in, the carrier is chopped at the modulator frequency
Picks how hard the gain knob drives
Sets the frequency of the modulator that shifts the carrier
Picks the band the modulator frequency knob works in
Sets the level of the synth output

inputs.text: Moves the carrier frequency, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the effect output level, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the drive, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Moves the modulator frequency, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
The left channel of the audio into the effect
The right channel of the audio into the effect
Adds to the synth output level, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
A voltage above 1V switches the modulator in and one below -1V switches it out, in place of the switch
A voltage above 1V takes the effect out of circuit and one below -1V puts it back, in place of the switch

outputs.text: The left channel of the processed audio
The right channel of the processed audio
The synth voice, which sounds on its own without anything patched into the audio inputs
